variants.title: Dielectric constant of PTFE by the slab-shift method
variants.unknown: the dielectric constant of PTFE at 9.5 GHz
variants.note: PTFE has one of the lowest permittivities of any solid and almost no loss.

source.title: A. R. von Hippel, Dielectric Materials and Applications: Teflon, relative permittivity 2.08 at 10 GHz

variants.title: Dielectric constant of fused silica glass by the slab-shift method
variants.unknown: the dielectric constant of fused silica at 9.5 GHz
variants.note: A 4 mm slab keeps beta_d l below pi/2 so the equation has one root.

source.title: A. R. von Hippel, Dielectric Materials and Applications: fused quartz, relative permittivity 3.78 at 10 GHz
